name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2522: A cold review found the raw values were kept by reference, and a snapshot exists precisely because references change - a caller mutating after the call leaves the contract check passing while the message prints the wrong value. A repr is taken at call time now. And the sentinel check could never fire for reach or sources, because dict and tuple conversions always succeed once the contract passes - the vestigial-guard defect I removed one version earlier, reappearing. Narrowed to pool, and the review named the case that makes it reachable.
